2608.12990.title: LycheeMemory V2: Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents via Semantic Segment-Level Consolidation
2608.12990.paper_summary: Long-horizon LLM agents must preserve information from past interactions to support future tasks. Existing memory systems typically rely on eager consolidation, invoking LLMs after each interaction to extract, summarize, or update memories. This design makes memory construction increasingly costly as conversations grow. Coarse summarization can reduce construction cost but risks discarding fine-grained contextual evidence, whereas larger retrieval contexts or multi-hop LLM reasoning shift the overhead to query time. We present LycheeMemory V2, an efficient long-term memory framework that replaces turn-level consolidation with semantic segment-level consolidation. Instead of consolidating every interaction, LycheeMemory batches multiple exchanges into segments and encodes each finalized segment into context-independent typed memory records. Segment-level batching lowers LLM encoding frequency, while semantic boundary detection helps preserve coherent event-level and temporal evidence compared with fixed-window batching. The resulting records are organized with lightweight structured indexes for query-planned evidence retrieval. Experiments using GPT-4.1-Mini show that LycheeMemory achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 89.22% on LoCoMo and 92.20% on LongMemEval-S. Compared with A-Mem, it reduces construction tokens by 86.0% on LoCoMo and 75.9% on LongMemEval-S without increasing query-time token usage. More broadly, our results suggest that the accuracy--cost trade-off of long-term agent memory depends not only on what information is retained, but also on the granularity at which it is consolidated.
2608.12990.paper_summary_zh: 長期的 LLM 代理必須保留過去互動的信息，以支持未來的任務。現有的記憶系統通常依賴於急切的整合，在每次互動後調用 LLM 以提取、總結或更新記憶。這種設計使得隨著對話的增長，記憶構建變得越來越昂貴。粗略的總結可以降低構建成本，但有丟棄細粒度上下文證據的風險，而更大的檢索上下文或多跳 LLM 推理則將開銷轉移到查詢時間。我們提出了 LycheeMemory V2，一個高效的長期記憶框架，將回合級整合替換為語義段級整合。LycheeMemory 不再整合每次互動，而是將多次交流批量處理成段，並將每個最終化的段編碼為上下文獨立的類型記憶記錄。段級批量處理降低了 LLM 編碼的頻率，而語義邊界檢測則有助於保留連貫的事件級和時間證據，相較於固定窗口批量處理。生成的記錄使用輕量級結構索引進行查詢計劃的證據檢索。使用 GPT-4.1-Mini 的實驗顯示，LycheeMemory 達到了最先進的性能，在 LoCoMo 上達到 89.22%，在 LongMemEval-S 上達到 92.20%。與 A-Mem 相比，它在 LoCoMo 上減少了 86.0% 的構建標記，在 LongMemEval-S 上減少了 75.9%，而不增加查詢時間的標記使用。更廣泛地說，我們的結果表明，長期代理記憶的準確性與成本的權衡不僅取決於保留了什麼信息，還取決於其整合的粒度。
